title: What If a Teaspoon of Neutron-star Matter Appeared on Earth?
description:
If you held a teaspoon of neutron star, what would happen first: its weight or its release?

Sources:
- NASA Science: https://science.nasa.gov/
- CERN: https://home.cern/science
- NIST: https://www.nist.gov/topics/physics

Illustrative visuals are labelled. Speculative outcomes are not presented as measured fact.

Impossible Brief · Episode 11 · One impossible scenario, worked through with real science, every day.
